summary: Full e2e testing of Plan & Tour app. Backend APIs all pass, LLM switched to gpt-4.1-nano (budget issue from iteration_1 is FIXED). Frontend flow works end-to-end: hero section loads beautifully, input validation works, AI generates Goa 3-day tour in ~7 seconds, all 3 tabs (Tour Plan, Premium Tour, Budget Tour) render correctly with INR pricing. Minor issue: 'Plan Another Trip' button scrolls to top but does not clear the destination input field.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Plan Another Trip', destination input is not cleared (still shows 'Goa'). Should reset to empty state.

issues: App design looks excellent - earthy/organic theme with deep green and terracotta, proper font usage (Outfit + Manrope), loading animation with destination marquee is visually appealing

action_items: LOW: Fix 'Plan Another Trip' to clear destination input and days input back to empty state
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured. gpt-4.1-nano model is cost-efficient and working well.
MongoDB _id excluded from history endpoint correctly (uses {'_id': 0} projection).
Static hotel/car images in PlanCard.jsx are hardcoded Pexels/Unsplash URLs - generic images, not destination-specific. Consider destination-aware images in future.
The TOUR_SYSTEM_PROMPT is 80+ lines inside server.py. As the app grows, consider moving it to a separate constants file for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all core flows work, minor reset issue

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. gpt-4.1-nano works fast (~7s for 3-day plan). All tabs render correctly. Only known issue: 'Plan Another Trip' doesn't clear form inputs. Test with Goa / 3 days. No auth required.
